admin.title: Virtual classroom · Zoom Server-to-Server
admin.description: Paste the Server-to-Server OAuth credentials of your Zoom account. They are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and never returned in plain text. If you leave them empty, the module falls back to the development stub.
admin.webhookSecretPlaceholder: (leave empty to keep the current one)
admin.webhookSecretHint: The "Secret Token" Zoom gives you when you set up your app's webhook, pointing at https://your-domain/api/v1/webhooks/zoom. Save it here BEFORE clicking "Validate" in Zoom: the validation request is signed with this token and, until it is saved, Didacta answers 401 and Zoom reports the URL as invalid. Without it, the virtual classroom receives no meeting start/end events.
admin.clearConfirm: Delete the Zoom S2S credentials? New sessions will fall back to the stub.
admin.testOk: ✓ Credentials are valid. Linked to Zoom account {accountId}.
admin.testStub: ⚠ The module is using the local stub — no real credentials are configured yet.
admin.webhookUrlLabel: URL to paste in Zoom (Event Subscriptions → Event notification endpoint URL)
admin.webhookOk: ✓ The webhook answers correctly at {url}. You can now click "Validate" in Zoom.
admin.webhookNoSecret: ✗ No Secret Token saved yet. Paste it above and save the credentials; until then Zoom gets a 401 and reports the URL as invalid.
admin.webhookUnreachable: ✗ Could not connect to {url} ({detail}). Check DNS, the certificate and that the proxy publishes that domain.
admin.webhookBadResponse: ✗ {url} answered 2xx but not with Zoom's handshake: something in front of Didacta (proxy, maintenance page) is replying instead.
